methodology.cohortDefinition: Every confirmed non-canary BUY linked to its signal and original fill. The journal supplies reconciled cash receipts, and the verified Polygon snapshot supplies final payout fractions for remaining held balances.
methodology.outcomeDefinition: Probability and outcome refer to the purchased side. Its binary payout per share is established by a reconciled token receipt or the finalized on-chain payout numerator divided by its denominator.
methodology.pnlFormula: Economic P&L = cash received + claimable payout − (confirmed shares × actual fill price + original recorded trading fee).
methodology.cashAndClaimDefinition: payoutUsd sums cashReceivedUsd and claimablePayoutUsd. Resolved unredeemed positions retain null cash-reconciliation timestamps and receipt sequence references.
methodology.costCorrectionDefinition: nonCanaryCostCorrectionUsd is the signed sum of journal position-cost adjustments linked to non-canary buys. Subtract it from original-fill economic P&L to obtain adjustedNetPnlUsd.
methodology.profitFactorFormula: Sum of positive per-position P&L divided by absolute sum of negative per-position P&L; per-position P&L is already net of recorded fees.
methodology.brierFormula: Mean of (purchased-side model probability − final purchased-side outcome)^2 over all confirmed non-canary buys.
methodology.marketAskBrierFormula: Mean of (decision-time purchased-side quoted ask − final purchased-side outcome)^2 over the same purchases. The displayed ask serves as a spread-bearing probability proxy.
methodology.robustnessDefinition: Remove the largest one or five positive recorded per-position P&Ls from the cohort sum. This is a retrospective concentration diagnostic, not a simulated alternative strategy or out-of-sample test.
methodology.timelineDefinition: dailyRealizedPnl groups the archived cash-reconciled purchases by cash-reconciliation date in UTC. dailySettlementPnl groups final economic P&L for all purchases retrospectively by the contract’s local weather event date. Each series starts at zero.
methodology.signalTimestampSemantics: signalTime is the journal append timestamp. Signal journal time may be later than evaluation; the freshness screen uses recorded quoteAgeAtEvaluationSeconds, not journal time minus quoteTime. The journal does not directly serialize the evaluation timestamp. quoteTime is null for the earliest included record because it was not recorded there. Recorded quote ages establish archived record consistency, not an independent audit of venue clocks.
limitations: Claimable payouts describe the recorded Polygon block and can change after redemption. The coverage export uses previously verified observations without making live account or venue requests.
Retrospective assignment by contract date gives hindsight results for each weather event. Actual payout availability and cash receipt can occur later.
Entry cost is cumulative trading turnover, not starting capital; dividing P&L by it does not produce account return.
P&L excludes gas costs, taxes, and any costs absent from the recorded fee field.
Calibration and Brier score describe the selected executed purchases. Forecasts that did not become confirmed buys are outside this population.
Multiple positions can share the same city and event date. They are correlated; no independent-trial confidence interval is asserted.
Small side, bucket, city, and probability-bin sample counts limit comparison. Empty bins have null rates, not zero rates.
Original-fill metrics omit subsequent journal cost adjustments. payoutCoverage separately reports their signed cost-basis effect and adjusted result. Technical-canary trades are excluded.
